verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a SaaS contract-management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of selecting a storage region or residency. The only related item (docs-43) describes using the API to copy signed agreements to an internal system, which is a developer workaround and not a residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
